title: 第18章 意不意外？惊不惊喜？
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
邵承先心情低落地回到了自己的座位，一口气灌了大半杯茶水，然后呸的一声，将嘴里的茶叶沫狠狠吐在了纸篓里。

    对面的黄莉莉看见这一幕，不禁有些好笑地问道：“咋地了哥们儿？让人给煮了？脸色这么难看呢？”

    邵承先冷哼了一声，没有搭理对方，自顾自地敲起了键盘打起了字。

    以前他总是眼馋黄莉莉那一对明晃晃的车头灯，所以经常带有目的性的和对方撩骚，幻想着哪天感情到位了，时机成熟了，好好增进一下同事友谊，安慰安慰这个姿色不俗的深闺怨妇。

    然而出乎他意料的是，别看黄莉莉平时满口虎狼之词，实际上却是严防死守，滴水不漏。

    后来他又把主意打到了徐丹身上，想着这位温婉秀丽的徐大姐正值虎狼之年，应该比黄莉莉更需要安慰。

    还有唐欣怡，刚结婚不久就和老公两地分居，每晚肯定寂寞的无法入睡，迫切需要人来陪。

    邵承先每天都在臆想着，结果一直臆想到了现在，依然还是思想上的巨人，行动上的矮子，半点儿便宜都没占着。

    现在办公室来了个比他年轻、比他帅的新人，不管黄莉莉、徐丹，还是唐欣怡，全都看人家不看他了。

    黄莉莉惨遭舔狗无视，不禁怔了一下，随后也是脸色一冷，把头一转。

    切，装什么装？平时总盯着老娘的胸看，以为老娘不知道？

    自从小梁来了，看你那鼻子不是鼻子脸不是脸的臭德行！

    呵，你再嫉妒也没用，人家就是比你高比你帅还比你有才华！

    想到这里，她故意提高了声音说道：“惟石，晚上有时间没，姐请客，吃烧烤。”

    梁惟石立刻响应道：“黄姐你是了解我的，有蹭吃蹭喝的机会我是绝不会错过的！”

    黄莉莉笑得眯起了眼睛，她就喜欢对方这股子爽利劲儿，大大方方，毫不做作，说话还幽默风趣，让她感觉就是舒服。

    哼，比起某个有贼心没贼胆、装模作样的伪君子强多了！

    “黄姐黄姐，我晚上也有时间！”唐欣怡笑嘻嘻地举起了手。

    “小唐你别捣乱，当心坏了你黄姐的好事。”

    徐丹一脸坏笑，转头又对黄莉莉说道：“老黄，你晚上可悠着点儿，别把人家惟石给吓跑了！”

    梁惟石连忙说道：“徐姐你是了解我的，我这个人没别的长处，就是胆子贼大，一些小场面根本吓不到我！”
content_en:
Shao Chengxian returned to his seat in a depressed mood, drank half a cup of tea in one breath, and then spit out the tea foam in his mouth into the wastebasket.

Huang Lili, who was opposite, saw this scene and couldn't help but asked in a funny tone: "What's wrong, buddy? Are you being cooked? Why do you look so ugly?"

Shao Chengxian snorted coldly, ignored the other party, and just typed on the keyboard.

In the past, he always coveted Huang Lili's pair of bright headlights, so he often flirted with her in a purposeful way, imagining that one day the relationship would be in place and the time would come, he would enhance the friendship between his colleagues and comfort this beautiful harem.

However, to his surprise, despite Huang Lili's usual talk of being a tiger and a wolf, she was actually very defensive and did not leak anything.

Later, he set his sights on Xu Dan, thinking that the gentle and beautiful Sister Xu was in her prime and needed comfort more than Huang Lili.

There is also Tang Xinyi. She and her husband lived apart soon after they got married. She must be so lonely that she cannot sleep every night and desperately needs someone to accompany her.

Shao Chengxian fantasizes about it every day, and the result is that even now, he is still a giant in thought and a dwarf in action, without taking any advantage.

Now there is a newcomer in the office who is younger and more handsome than him. No matter Huang Lili, Xu Dan, or Tang Xinyi, they all look at others rather than him.

Huang Lili was stunned for a moment when she was ignored by the licking dog. Then her face turned cold and she turned her head.

Come on, what should I pretend to be?You always stare at my mother’s breasts, do you think I don’t know?

Since Xiao Liang came, look at your stinky behavior of having a nose that is not a nose but a face that is not a face!

Oh, it’s useless no matter how jealous you are, they are just taller, more handsome and more talented than you!

Thinking of this, she deliberately raised her voice and said, "Wei Shi, if you have time tonight, I'll treat you to a barbecue."

Liang Weishi responded immediately: "Sister Huang, you know me well. I will never miss the opportunity to eat and drink!"

Huang Lili smiled so hard that she narrowed her eyes. She liked the other party's refreshing energy, openness and no pretense, and his humorous speech, which made her feel comfortable.

Humph, it’s much better than some pretentious hypocrite who has a thief’s heart but no courage!

"Sister Huang, Sister Huang, I also have time in the evening!" Tang Xinyi raised her hand with a smile.

"Xiao Tang, please don't cause trouble, or you may ruin your sister Huang's good deeds."

Xu Dan had a bad smile on his face, turned around and said to Huang Lili: "Old Huang, you should take it easy at night, don't scare Wei Shi away!"

Liang Weishi said quickly: "Sister Xu, you know me well. I have no other strengths, except that I am very courageous. Some small scenes cannot scare me at all!"
title_en: Chapter 18 Is it unexpected?Surprised or not?
